android.description: Android screens/viewmodels and new feature-package files must wire AnalyticsPort + funnel step + Crashlytics on failure paths.

admin_web.description: admin-web routes/screens must wire a Faro/analytics event and/or error boundary coverage.

screen_view.description: Every Compose top-level screen/route destination (a public @Composable fun *Screen(...)/*Route(...)) must emit a screen-view event. Best-effort: this is a marker-presence check over the whole file/sibling, it does NOT verify the marker is actually reachable from the @Composable entry point, nor that it is inside a route/id-keyed LaunchedEffect (see docs/TELEMETRY.md for the LaunchedEffect-keying rule, which this guard cannot statically verify).

primary_action.description: Best-effort: an onClick block that itself performs a write/navigation call (navController.navigate/popBackStack, a *ViewModel submit/save/delete call spelled out inline, or a direct outbox/repository write) should carry an analytics call in the same lexical block. Cannot see analytics wired one function-call away (e.g. onClick = { viewModel.onSubmitClicked() } with the analytics call living inside onSubmitClicked()) — that is the single biggest class of false positive, which is why this surface is WARN not FAIL. Treat WARN findings as a worklist, not a gate.

failure_outcome.description: Best-effort: a ViewModel that has a catch/Result-failure branch reaching the UI should carry a *_FAILURE/*_FAILED analytics event (with a reason code param) alongside CrashReporter/non-fatal recording. This overlaps intentionally with exception-guard (which enforces 'record it somewhere') — this surface additionally wants a user-facing outcome/failure ANALYTICS event, not just a crash record. File-level marker-presence only; cannot verify the failure event actually carries a reason-code parameter (see docs/TELEMETRY.md for the required-params convention) or that it fires on the exact failing branch. WARN because of that gap.
